# S2 plan section 5: "before" and "after" pairs for the warm runtime's removal,
# taken by the same harness on both binaries, one after the other in one
# container:
#
#   before: the 0.17.0-alpha.2 release, bin/linux-arm64/plugin from
#           lattice-plugin-sub-store-0.17.0-alpha.2.tar.gz, whose SHA-256
#           b1f769f8d558e9c991099956e884e7e95c7a64e32aef89ebe100a81ca8b1e307
#           is the signed manifest's bundle digest (the installed artifact)
#   after:  this branch at 05db0a9, built with CGO_ENABLED=0 -trimpath
#           -buildvcs=false, as the release builds it
#
# Host: golang:1.26.9-bookworm, linux/arm64, 4 vCPUs (colima on an Apple M3),
# 2026-10-16. The machine was shared with other suites (load average 13 to 34
# on 8 cores), which moves the latency figures and not the resident set.
#
# Harnesses: TestWorkerVmRSS (memory_linux_test.go: idle VmRSS once settled,
# then three 4096-node sing-box converts through framed stdin) and
# TestWorkerBundleCallLatency (worker_latency_linux_test.go: four converts of
# 64 links to Loon, which reach the embedded bundle), both with
# LATTICE_WORKER_BINARY naming the binary. The before binary fails
# TestWorkerVmRSS's S2 bounds by design; its figures are the record.
#
# The config-file render before and after is the deploy's production
# measurement (plan section 5); it needs the host's KV and is not taken here.
